description:
Large TUMI wheeled upright duffel in black ballistic nylon with a telescoping metal pull handle, two inline wheels, webbing carry handles, a removable shoulder strap, front and side zip pockets, and a lined main compartment with compression straps. The interior identification plate is marked with the model reference 22042D4. Included is an Authenticate First certificate of authenticity issued to Goodwill P. Sold as is.

Condition: Scuffing and paint transfer on the wheel housings and bottom skid rails, light soiling and marks on the nylon panels, minor scuffs on the handle.

shippingPolicy:
SHIPPING:

"ALL ITEMS/COMBINED ITEMS OVER $100.00 WILL REQUIRE A SIGNATURE"

Items are shipped within 5 working days depending on the season. Shipping business days are Monday through Friday 7am - 3pm. We are closed on weekends and holidays.

We cannot guarantee that we will get and be able to apply alternative address if different than what is on customer's account. We will do our best to make sure items are shipped out to address requested.

IF YOU HAVE US FILE A CLAIM WITH FED EX FOR NON-DELIVERY REFUND WILL HAVE TO WAIT UNTIL FED EX RESPONDS TO THE CLAIM, UNTIL THAT TIME MONEY WILL NOT BE REFUNDED. IF FED EX STATES THAT THEY DELIVERED THE ITEM CORRECTLY AND YOU DID NOT RECEIVE THE ITEM IT MAY HAVE BEEN STOLEN FROM YOUR PROPERTY AND WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR THEFT OF ITEMS.

ITEMS ARE NOT SHIPPED BY COST OF ACTUAL WEIGHT. ITEMS ARE SHIPPED AND CHARGED BY SIZE OF THE BOX THESE ITEM/ITEMS ARE SHIPPED IN. THIS IS CALLED DIM WEIGHT BY FED EX (AND UPS). THIS IS HOW WE ARE CHARGED FOR SHIPPING AND THIS IS HOW WE CHARGE OUR CUSTOMERS FOR SHIPPING. THIS PROCESS OF SHIPPING HAS BEEN THIS WAY FOR MORE THAN 2 YEARS. 


COMBINED SHIPPING:

Items that are already paid for cannot be combined with another item and shipping weight will not be adjusted.

Items that can safely be combined in the same box may be done at the time of payment. These items are not blocked from combining. Items that are blocked need prior contact from us to assure that the items will arrive safely to your home. Please be aware Shop Goodwill will only allow up to 20lbs. to be combined at one time.

Combined Shipping will accumulate $3.00 for each item up to $6.00 for 2 items. If you purchase more than 2 items then there is no additional charge for handling. Handling fee is non-refundable.


PLEASE BE AWARE YOU CANNOT COMBINE BUY IT NOW ITEMS WITH OTHER ORDERS - THESE ARE RULES SET IN PLACE BY ORANGE COUNTY GOODWILL WHO RUNS THE SITE.
sellerItemProfile:
Items are shipped using a major carrier usually within 5 business days after receipt of payment. Shipping charges are calculated at payment time.



CONDITION DEFINITIONS

Like New: In new or perfect condition with original packing or tags. Free of blemishes or flaws (unless noted in description).

Very Good: Could show minimal use/wear. Very clean and undamaged with no odor or marks (unless noted in description).

Good: Shows minor wear/use. No damage to this item will affect intended use.

Fair: Will show wear/use/damage. Still nothing should be missing.

Poor: This item is sold as is and unknown if complete or in working condition.
